content.title: About
content.content: Cream NS is a versatile dairy base available in three variants: light, heavy and half‑and‑half. It is made from whole milk and cream, contains no artificial flavors or stabilizers, and is suitable for baking, desserts and sauces.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Light cream contains about 10 % fat, making it ideal for diet‑friendly dishes.
Heavy cream has over 35 % fat, providing a richer texture and more intense flavor.
Half‑and‑half combines properties of both light and heavy cream, offering a balanced creaminess.
Cream NS is produced without trans‑fats and is suitable for vegetarians.
Opened product keeps for up to 7 days in the refrigerator at 2‑4 °C.

items.title: Source of Vitamin A
items.content: The fat component of the cream is rich in vitamin A, which supports vision and immune function.

items.title: Contains Calcium
items.content: Calcium in the cream contributes to strong bones and teeth.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: B2 and B12 vitamins help with energy metabolism and nervous system health.

items.title: Digestive Support
items.content: Light cream’s lower fat content is easier on sensitive stomachs.

items.title: Satiety
items.content: The higher fat in heavy cream promotes a longer feeling of fullness.

items.title: Milk protein allergy
items.content: Cream may trigger allergic reactions in individuals with lactose intolerance or casein allergy.

items.title: High fat content
items.content: Heavy cream is rich in saturated fats; consume in moderation.

items.title: Shelf life after opening
items.content: Improper storage can lead to spoilage and food‑borne illness.

items.title: Temperature control
items.content: Cream can separate when overheated, affecting texture.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Light cream is perfect for salad dressings, sauces and light desserts. Heavy cream is used in pastries, cakes and rich fillings. Half‑and‑half is versatile for sauces, soups‑purees and baked goods where moderate richness is desired.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the cream in its original container in the refrigerator at 2‑4 °C. After opening, keep the lid tightly sealed. Discard if you notice sour odor or discoloration.
